evidence_summary: Source units establish CRA as a continuous risk management process (v7u_N002828), state the rule to conduct CRA before onboarding and review upon changes (v7u_N002829), and explain its purpose to detect changes and reassess risks (v7u_N002836). Target units define CRA and its purpose (v7u_N003040), and classify key risk elements: customer profile (v7u_N003042), jurisdiction (v7u_N003043), and transactional behavior (v7u_N003046), directly applying and expanding the foundational CRA concept.

p4_relation.p4b_reason: CH38 provides the rule and purpose of Customer Risk Assessment (CRA) as a continuous process; CH42 defines CRA and classifies its key risk elements, directly applying and expanding the CRA concept. CH38 grounds CH42 by establishing the foundational requirement.
p4_relation.review_reason: Accepted: the relation matches the strict P4 contract after review of the candidate CP titles, P2A reasons, and selected unit evidence.
p4_relation.target_title_en: Customer Risk Assessment (CRA) definition and key risk elements
